install.notes: README.md:21-29 creates a Python 3.6 conda environment and installs requirements.txt (gym==0.14.0, pybullet, numpy, scipy). The gate and the fake backend need none of that: fake.py is pure Python and runs on the SDK's Python 3.10+, and the gate never installs or imports the upstream package. Install the upstream only to serve the real environment (backend sim), which was not run.
